name: mofli-workspace
description: Framework-independent interactive creatures with extensible rigs and validated skins

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: prettier --write packages apps test docs README.md package.json scripts
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run build:studio
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build:demo && npm run test:packages
